item.title: Reschedule a volunteer shift
item.context_text: You are helping at a neighbourhood book exchange. An exam trip now conflicts with your volunteer shift.
item.objective_text: Ask for a workable swap and explain what the new volunteer must do.
item.target_grammar: Polite conditionals and requests with would and could.
success_conditions: Ask for a workable swap and explain what the new volunteer must do.
Offer set-up or the 9 am slot
Say the shift starts at noon

children.title: Check the details
children.instructions: Read the message and use its details to answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
SATURDAY BOOK EXCHANGE
Set-up 09:00–10:00: label boxes and put signs outdoors. Desk 10:00–12:00: sign in donations. Pack-up 12:00–13:00: count leftover books and take boxes inside. For a swap, email the coordinator by Thursday afternoon with your replacement's name. Madina can only help at noon. You can arrive at 9:00 but must leave at 10:30.

questions.prompt: Which full shift could Madina take?
questions.explanation: Madina is available from noon. Pack-up starts at noon and lasts until 1 pm.

questions.prompt: What must the coordinator receive by Thursday afternoon?
options: A copy of your exam schedule
questions.explanation: The instructions ask for an email with the replacement's name.

children.title: Write to the coordinator
children.instructions: Your original shift is pack-up. Request the swap and offer to cover the full set-up slot instead.
children.prompt_text: Coordinator: Please email me your replacement's name and what you can cover.
children.goal: Identify the replacement and offer the 9 am set-up slot.

points.label: Offer set-up or the 9 am slot

children.model_answer: Hi Dilshod, could Madina cover my pack-up shift on Saturday? I need to leave by 10:30, but I can cover the complete 9:00–10:00 set-up slot. Would that work?

children.title: Brief your replacement
children.instructions: Tell Madina when to arrive and explain the two jobs at pack-up.
children.prompt_text: Madina: What do I need to do when I get there?

points.label: Say the shift starts at noon

children.model_answer: Please arrive at noon. First count the leftover books and write down the total. Then take the boxes inside so the courtyard is clear.
